text:
User is preparing a supply order for the Jorton depot.
- Add 120 lanterns to the order.
- Task: Send Vik, Leon, Suri, and Dell notes from respective meetings.
- People Out: Jonah (Leon covering), Finn (Wren covering), Wren (Una covering), Hugo (Rafe covering), Teo (Finn covering). Una is out for the rest of the week; Mira is covering.
- Desk Swaps: Mira/Dell, Opal/Cora, Ada/Kira, Nils/Opal, Leon/Nils, Leon/Cora, Mira/Suri, Teo/Greta.
- Review Preferences: Leon (east wing), Suri (garden studio), Rafe (harbour room), Una (north office), Teo (harbour room), Opal (loading bay), Hugo (east wing), Kira (east wing).
- Room Clear Requests: Nils (north office), Hugo (library annex), Wren (library annex), Teo (garden studio), Leon (garden studio), Pia (east wing), Suri (harbour room), Teo (north office).
- Repainting/Noise: Loading bay/east wing (morning/afternoon/evening), North office/print room (afternoon/morning), Harbour room (morning), Garden studio (afternoon), Print room (afternoon), Library annex (evening). North office repainting causes afternoon noise.
- Cold Rooms: Mira (east wing afternoon), Ada (loading bay morning), Esme (print room evening), Opal (garden studio afternoon), Ines (harbour room evening), Vik (print room evening), Nils (library annex evening), Wren (north office morning), Wren (harbour room afternoon), Rafe (harbour room evening). Finn thinks harbour room is too cold in the evening.
- Working Coffee Machines: Library annex, east wing, loading bay, harbour room, print room, garden studio.
- Slow Lifts: Near east wing, library annex, harbour room, north office, garden studio, loading bay.
- Stand-ups: Afternoon moved to library annex. Evening (north office).
- Room Availability: Kira asked if harbour room is free in evening. Opal asked if garden studio is free in evening. Hugo asked if print room is free in evening. Teo asked if loading bay is free in morning.
- Misc: Umbrella left in print room. Teo finds east wing too cold in afternoon. Kira thinks garden studio is too cold in morning.
